title: Move the Tactus books (Learning, Programming, In-a-Nutshell) off Quarto to Markus
description: Three Quarto books with PDF/EPUB targets. Needs Markus print/EPUB renderers (listed as later in the Markus README) before a faithful move. Web edition can move first.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Inventory done 2026-10-18 (read-only clones of the three books and Tactus-examples). The books are nearly plain Markdown: no callouts, cross-references, citations or diagrams. Quarto-specific pieces: the part/chapter tree in _quarto.yml, 15 code-include fences with snippet markers (Learning-Tactus only), 4 meta shortcodes fed by book-links.yml and tactus-target.yml, and a cover page. The web edition can move now on the shared docs builder (Papyrus PR 308) plus three generic additions; PDF stays on the Quarto job until a Papyrus print output exists. Full plan: /mnt/project-files/anthus-sites-to-papyrus/tactus-books-inventory-and-plan.md. Tactus-examples is not a site and needs no conversion.
